Class AbstractUrlBasedView

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.context.support.ApplicationObjectSupport
org.springframework.web.context.support.WebApplicationObjectSupport
org.springframework.web.servlet.view.AbstractView
org.springframework.web.servlet.view.AbstractUrlBasedView
All Implemented Interfaces:
Aware, BeanNameAware, InitializingBean, ApplicationContextAware, ServletContextAware, View
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbstractPdfStamperView, AbstractTemplateView, InternalResourceView, RedirectView, ScriptTemplateView, XsltView
public abstract class AbstractUrlBasedView extends AbstractView implements InitializingBean
基于 URL 的视图的抽象基类。提供了一种一致的方式来持有视图所包装的 URL，形式为"url"bean 属性。
Since:
13.12.2003
Author:
Jürgen Hoeller

    • afterPropertiesSet

      public void afterPropertiesSet() throws Exception
      描述从接口复制：InitializingBean
      Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.

      此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

      Specified by:
      `afterPropertiesSet` 接口 `InitializingBean` 中
      Throws:
      Exception - 在配置错误（例如未设置必需属性）或因任何其他原因导致初始化失败的情况下

    • isUrlRequired

      protected boolean isUrlRequired()
      Return whether the 'url' property is required.

      默认实现返回true。 这可以在子类中重写。

      public boolean checkResource(Locale locale) throws Exception
      检查配置 URL 指向的底层资源是否实际存在。

      Returns:
